_comment: Pass/fail limits for the Phase 3 evaluation set, fixed after the first full run
(docs/phase-3-lld.md decision E9: targets chosen before seeing results get gamed).
EvalRunner fails the run when a limit is missed and names every one that was.
Every accuracy limit here is the 'first goal' from LLD section 7, written before any
result was known. The 2026-10-20 baseline beat all of them outright, so none has been
relaxed to fit what the pipeline happens to do - the margin between these numbers and
the baseline is headroom for model variance, not a lowered bar.
Never loosen a limit to make a run pass. Fix the pipeline, or raise it as a finding
(docs/phase-3-findings.md) and get the change approved with a written reason.
_maxInScopeLeaksComment: The target is zero, and this is not a pass - it is recorded debt, set to today's known
count so the gate catches a *new* leak (a third) instead of being permanently red and
therefore ignored. The two are the approved KNOWN_MISSES in MaskingRegressionTest, both
in pii-names-everywhere, both the same structural limitation: a name with no recognised
label and no honorific. 'Reviewed by Victor Hammond.' (no colon, so the labelled-name
rule deliberately does not reach it) and 'Note: Grace Liu was seen...' (free prose).
Lower this to 0 if the OpenNLP name rule is turned on and proves it catches them.
ADDRESS is excluded entirely - it is the documented Phase 2 gap, LLD decision E6.
